from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document extracted from the input collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document, including case number if present")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) as explicitly stated in the document")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the text containing the cause of action")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument] = Field(description="List of judgment documents found in the processed input")
